title: Decision JM-1: credential identity stays the user URI (H1)
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (5630c10) §keypackage and Room/create rule 2 make the credential identity a 'client URI bound to the account'; H1 (mimid-1wgh.6.1) makes it the user URI, which the hub participant check, relay identity checks and KeyPackage upload rely on. Readings: (a) revisit H1, which needs a client-to-user mapping protocol-06 lacks; (b) keep H1 and read 'client URI' as mimid's derived client URI (.7.8, from the leaf signature key), with the existing client table as the binding. Chosen: (b). The draft is to be reworded (via crate-jmap-50).
